_help: Draft & Trade Ledger. Picks and trades are pulled automatically, and picks are now GRADED automatically: at 12, 24 and 36 months after the pick (measured from the draft date Sleeper reports, or drafts.<year>.date here, else Sept 1 of the draft year), each pick gets a hit / mid / bust verdict from its position rank in the season just finished (thresholds under grading.hit and grading.mid; picks after grading.late_round can't be busts), nudged one step up or down when his actual points beat or missed Sleeper's projection for the weeks he played (grading.projection.over / under). Hand-enter only what the machine cannot know. verdicts: key 'YEAR:R.SS' (e.g. '2026:1.01') -> {grade: hit|mid|bust, note}; a hand verdict always overrides the automatic one. trades: key = Sleeper trade id (see data/<year>/transactions.json) -> {status: deceased|alive|pending, headline, cause, obituary, survived_by}; 'deceased' trades get an obituary card at the top of the Blockbuster Registry. drafts: key = season -> {label, date (optional YYYY-MM-DD, only when Sleeper does not report a draft date)}.
